title: Verify three exact certificates from a degree-two K3 computation

source.citation: Nicolas Addington, Benjamin Antieau, Sarah Frei, and Katrina Honigs, Rational points and derived equivalence, arXiv:1906.02261

translation.notes: Three exact univariate checks are independently entered from the paper's accompanying Magma calculations: factor the Tate-normalized Weil polynomial, recover square roots of two restricted sextics, and isolate the unique real root of a critical-value eliminant. The larger K3 point-count and bad-prime searches remain scale-blocked.
